- **build()**: Standard cmake/ninja build with Release configuration.
- **package()**: Standard installation of the binary, themes, QML modules, desktop entry, icon, AppStream metainfo, and license into conventional filesystem locations.

No evidence of obfuscation, unexpected network destinations, data exfiltration, backdoors, or any behavior that deviates from standard packaging practices.
